selections.sense: the written or graphic product information presented with goods
selections.levelRationale: Discussing whether supplied information is clear or complete requires the information system, beyond naming a tag in A2-H118/B1-H207.
selections.lowerLevelContrast: A2 etiqueta is the attached label; this result/information meaning may share a parent but is not automatically its physical object.
selections.register: neutral; descriptive consumer use, not professional instruction
selections.region: Pan-Hispanic unless a form note narrows usage; es-ES audio target
selections.formNotes: Masculine mass; el etiquetado de un producto; process of attaching labels not separately selected.
selections.pronunciationNotes: e-ti-que-TA-do; qu=/k/, silent u.
uncertainties: Granularity between collective label information and etiqueta requires global review; framework12.1 names etiqueta rather than this exact noun.

selections.sense: an amount of food separated or allocated for serving
selections.levelRationale: Retain B1-H026 serving-amount proposal despite B2 illustrative seed: comparing labels does not create a new portion sense.
selections.lowerLevelContrast: B1-H026 and A2-H177/B1-H244 ración overlap; do not count every numerical portion.
selections.register: neutral; descriptive consumer use, not professional instruction
selections.region: Pan-Hispanic unless a form note narrows usage; es-ES audio target
selections.formNotes: Feminine; porciones loses written accent; una porción de.
selections.pronunciationNotes: por-CIÓN, por-CIO-nes; io glide, c /θ/ in reference es-ES.
uncertainties: Same-sense B1 proposal versus B2 planning seed; ración synonym/granularity remains unresolved.

selections.sense: a building's protection against transmission of heat or sound
selections.levelRationale: Compare dwelling performance and explain a comfort problem using the barrier property rather than simply cold/noisy.
selections.lowerLevelContrast: B1-H100/101 noise and H073 moisture describe observed states; this identifies a protective system/property, not social isolation.
selections.register: neutral; descriptive consumer use, not professional instruction
selections.region: Pan-Hispanic unless a form note narrows usage; es-ES audio target
selections.formNotes: Masculine; aislamiento térmico/acústico; count material/system variants only if later adjudicated.
selections.pronunciationNotes: ais-la-MIEN-to; ai and ie glides in ordinary pronunciation; aísla has stressed í hiatus.
uncertainties: Independent building-use nomination, not a literal PCIC B2 headword claim; thermal/acoustic implementations are proposed one insulation meaning.

selections.sense: an unexpected problem affecting the normal course of a service
selections.levelRationale: Reuse B1-T028 service-problem recommendation for a housing incident report; topic shift is not later introduction.
selections.lowerLevelContrast: B1-T028 already names this service disruption; distinguish statistical incidence or a neutral event if selected later.
selections.register: neutral; descriptive consumer use, not professional instruction
selections.region: Pan-Hispanic unless a form note narrows usage; es-ES audio target
selections.formNotes: Feminine; incidencias; comunicar/registrar una incidencia.
selections.pronunciationNotes: in-ci-DEN-cia; final ia glide, c /θ/ under distinction.
uncertainties: B2 seed conflicts with actual B1 peer; fault versus broad service-event granularity needs adjudication.

selections.sense: the process by which a body obtains and uses nourishment
selections.levelRationale: Allows a general explanation of food choices in terms of nourishment, not a clinical mechanism or prescribed diet.
selections.lowerLevelContrast: B1-H008 nutriente names a component; this names the overall bodily process, distinct alimentación selection below.
selections.register: neutral; descriptive consumer use, not professional instruction
selections.region: Pan-Hispanic unless a form note narrows usage; es-ES audio target
selections.formNotes: Feminine normally mass; nutrición; adjective nutricional is a linked form-family proposal, not another counted sense.
selections.pronunciationNotes: nu-tri-CIÓN; tr cluster and io glide.
uncertainties: Original general-audience selection; a heading called diet/nutrition does not certify the word's introduction.

selections.sense: the habitual provision and intake of food
selections.levelRationale: Propose B1 for the dietary-practice noun supported by specific5.1 B1, not move it later because the discussion is justified.
selections.lowerLevelContrast: Earlier comer food intake and B1-Hfood components support the habit; no earlier exact noun saved in inspected peers.
selections.register: neutral; descriptive consumer use, not professional instruction
selections.region: Pan-Hispanic unless a form note narrows usage; es-ES audio target
selections.formNotes: Feminine; una alimentación equilibrada; mass practice, not electrical power supply.
selections.pronunciationNotes: a-li-men-ta-CIÓN; final stress and io glide.
uncertainties: Independent B1 placement, awaiting P/H/F ownership and global introduction review.

selections.sense: having appropriately proportioned components in the selected diet or arrangement
selections.levelRationale: Specific5.1 B1 balanced eating supports this qualitative relation before B2 dietary argument.
selections.lowerLevelContrast: B1-H components plus enough/too much support the concept; no prior exact adjective saved. Not merely physically stable.
selections.register: neutral; descriptive consumer use, not professional instruction
selections.region: Pan-Hispanic unless a form note narrows usage; es-ES audio target
selections.formNotes: equilibrado/equilibrada and plurals; agreeing adjective; equilibrar verb not automatically selected.
selections.pronunciationNotes: e-qui-li-BRA-do; silent u in qui, br cluster.
uncertainties: Proposed B1 first introduction; nutrition and broader proportion sense may share one meaning with F.

selections.sense: providing nourishment as food
selections.levelRationale: Distinguish nourishment from taste or an asserted overall health benefit; specific12.3 B2 supplies this food property.
selections.lowerLevelContrast: A1 rico tastes pleasant; B1 nutriente names component. Checked later5.1/13.1 C1 also has this adjective, not proof of a C1 minimum.
selections.register: neutral; descriptive consumer use, not professional instruction
selections.region: Pan-Hispanic unless a form note narrows usage; es-ES audio target
selections.formNotes: nutritivo/nutritiva; alimentos nutritivos; no automatic nutritional-health guarantee.
selections.pronunciationNotes: nu-tri-TI-vo; tr cluster and /b/ for v.
uncertainties: B2 shopping column versus C1 diet/health occurrence; scope is food nourishment, not medical efficacy.

selections.sense: intended for or relating to food and nourishment
selections.levelRationale: Supports distinguishing a food product or additive from a visually similar nonfood product; specific5.1/12.3 B2.
selections.lowerLevelContrast: Earlier alimento/ingrediente component names do not themselves supply this relational classification.
selections.register: neutral; descriptive consumer use, not professional instruction
selections.region: Pan-Hispanic unless a form note narrows usage; es-ES audio target
selections.formNotes: alimenticio/alimenticia; producto alimenticio; avoid making all relational adjective inflections separate.
selections.pronunciationNotes: a-li-men-TI-cio; final io glide and c /θ/ under distinction.
uncertainties: Relational versus nourishing uses can overlap nutritivo; keep selected classification narrow.

selections.sense: a substance added to help preserve a food product
selections.levelRationale: Name the additive category when reading or querying contents, following specific5.1/12.3 B2.
selections.lowerLevelContrast: B1-H014 contener plus sin permits composition; preserved is not the same as frozen, fresh or clinically safe.
selections.register: neutral; descriptive consumer use, not professional instruction
selections.region: Pan-Hispanic unless a form note narrows usage; es-ES audio target
selections.formNotes: Masculine count/mass; conservantes; sin conservantes is compositional, not another word.
selections.pronunciationNotes: con-ser-VAN-te; final e audible.
uncertainties: No assertion that absence is healthier or that presence guarantees safety.

selections.sense: a substance used to give colour to a product
selections.levelRationale: Differentiate colouring from preserving when comparing declared additives; specific5.1 B2.
selections.lowerLevelContrast: Earlier color names appearance, not a substance deliberately added; same noun can cover nonfood products.
selections.register: neutral; descriptive consumer use, not professional instruction
selections.region: Pan-Hispanic unless a form note narrows usage; es-ES audio target
selections.formNotes: Masculine; colorantes; colorante alimenticio; nonfood use shares core unless evidence demands a split.
selections.pronunciationNotes: co-lo-RAN-te; single r tap.
uncertainties: Shared food/material meaning proposed; no automatic nutrition judgment.

selections.sense: a substance added to a product to modify a property
selections.levelRationale: Supplies the broader category joining preservative and colouring in a consumer question rather than an exhaustive chemistry list.
selections.lowerLevelContrast: B1 ingrediente can be any recipe component; aditivo selects a functional addition.
selections.register: neutral; descriptive consumer use, not professional instruction
selections.region: Pan-Hispanic unless a form note narrows usage; es-ES audio target
selections.formNotes: Masculine; aditivos; aditivo de/en un producto; adjective use not separately selected.
selections.pronunciationNotes: a-di-TI-vo; /b/ for v and clear initial a.
uncertainties: Original label-scenario nomination, not an official PCIC lexical assignment.

selections.sense: containing a relatively small amount of a specified component
selections.levelRationale: Specific5.1/12.3 B2 low-in descriptors support comparisons of named constituents without importing legal numerical thresholds.
selections.lowerLevelContrast: A1-F184 vertical low and A1-D076 low voice are distinct uses; quantity language is an earlier prerequisite.
selections.register: neutral; descriptive consumer use, not professional instruction
selections.region: Pan-Hispanic unless a form note narrows usage; es-ES audio target
selections.formNotes: bajo/baja en + component; agree with product, not component; alto en is comparison construction requiring F review.
selections.pronunciationNotes: BA-jo; j velar/regionally glottal; en is unstressed.
uncertainties: Degree sense may share F general low amount; product-label use does not establish regulated eligibility.

selections.sense: containing a relatively large amount of a specified component
selections.levelRationale: Specific5.1/12.3 B2 rich-in framing distinguishes constituent abundance from pleasant taste.
selections.lowerLevelContrast: Baseline/A1-H049 means tasty; A2-S044 wealthy is another meaning; retain IDs only as different-sense links.
selections.register: neutral; descriptive consumer use, not professional instruction
selections.region: Pan-Hispanic unless a form note narrows usage; es-ES audio target
selections.formNotes: Regular agreeing adjective rico/rica and plurals; rico en + component; no irregular adjective morphology.
selections.pronunciationNotes: RI-co; initial strong r, c=/k/.
uncertainties: Sense split from taste and wealth proposed; label claims are reported, not certified.

selections.sense: made using the whole grain rather than only a refined part
selections.levelRationale: Recognize the grain-processing contrast in product comparison, supported by specific5.3 B2 bread context.
selections.lowerLevelContrast: Earlier pan names food and B1 fibra a component; wholegrain is not identical to fibre content or health-promoting.
selections.register: neutral; descriptive consumer use, not professional instruction
selections.region: Pan-Hispanic unless a form note narrows usage; es-ES audio target
selections.formNotes: Gender invariant integral; integrales; pan/harina integral.
selections.pronunciationNotes: in-te-GRAL; gr cluster, final l.
uncertainties: Not every general complete/integrated sense included; earlier practical introduction remains possible.

selections.sense: having the cream or much of the milk fat removed
selections.levelRationale: Specific5.3 B1 dairy descriptors support an earlier product-choice introduction.
selections.lowerLevelContrast: B1-H010 grasa names component; the adjective labels processing, not lactose-free status.
selections.register: neutral; descriptive consumer use, not professional instruction
selections.region: Pan-Hispanic unless a form note narrows usage; es-ES audio target
selections.formNotes: desnatado/desnatada; semidesnatado linked contrast needs final form/sense policy; descremado regional lexical variant.
selections.pronunciationNotes: des-na-TA-do; maintain initial des; descreMAdo variant stress.
uncertainties: Proposed B1. Semidesnatado explicitly indicates partial removal and should not be silently treated as identical; final form/sense policy must resolve that product contrast.

selections.sense: produced under the agricultural practices denoted by organic food labelling
selections.levelRationale: Specific5.1 B2 product descriptor supports interpreting a production-method claim, not judging medical benefit.
selections.lowerLevelContrast: B1-W157 derived-from-living-matter is a different selected sense; ecological impact and label certification are not interchangeable.
selections.register: neutral; descriptive consumer use, not professional instruction
selections.region: Pan-Hispanic unless a form note narrows usage; es-ES audio target
selections.formNotes: orgánico/orgánica; orgánicos; ecológico/bio vary in usage and jurisdiction, not automatic exact variants.
selections.pronunciationNotes: or-GÁ-ni-co; written accent, four syllables; both g and c velar stops.
uncertainties: Production-label scope must not imply universally identical rules or healthier food; original lexical gloss only.

selections.sense: changed from its raw form by preparation or industrial treatment
selections.levelRationale: Allows a consumer to distinguish processing from freshness or additive presence when explaining a food choice.
selections.lowerLevelContrast: B1-H028 casero describes origin/style; frozen and cooked are specific processes, not exhaustive equivalents.
selections.register: neutral; descriptive consumer use, not professional instruction
selections.region: Pan-Hispanic unless a form note narrows usage; es-ES audio target
selections.formNotes: procesado/procesada; alimento procesado; process verb and ultra- subtype not automatically separate.
selections.pronunciationNotes: pro-ce-SA-do; pro cluster, c /θ/ in es-ES.
uncertainties: Original food-choice nomination; no medical ranking of degrees of processing.

selections.sense: sweetened by adding sugar
selections.levelRationale: Explain a beverage preference by sweetening rather than taste alone, complementing B2 component descriptors.
selections.lowerLevelContrast: A1 dulce is perceived sweetness, which can occur without added sugar; selected adjective must keep that distinction.
selections.register: neutral; descriptive consumer use, not professional instruction
selections.region: Pan-Hispanic unless a form note narrows usage; es-ES audio target
selections.formNotes: Agreeing result adjective azucarado/azucarada from azucarar in its literal sugar-sweetening use; broader sugary-tasting and figurative flattering uses excluded.
selections.pronunciationNotes: a-zu-ca-RA-do; z /θ/ reference, c /k/.
uncertainties: Selected sugar-added participial/result scope is supported by RAE azucarar; do not infer this process from sweet taste alone. Form-derived adjective versus verb-family counting remains open.

selections.sense: the bodily process of breaking down ingested food
selections.levelRationale: Specific5.1 B2 supports describing an ordinary food experience without a medical mechanism or diagnosis.
selections.lowerLevelContrast: B1 restriction/intolerance reports are not the process itself; no earlier exact noun saved.
selections.register: neutral; descriptive consumer use, not professional instruction
selections.region: Pan-Hispanic unless a form note narrows usage; es-ES audio target
selections.formNotes: Feminine; hacer la digestión; digestiones for episodes, not plural as new sense.
selections.pronunciationNotes: di-ges-TIÓN; g before e fricative, io glide.
uncertainties: Shared P physiological-process ownership; no safety instructions about timing or swimming.

selections.sense: break down ingested food through digestion
selections.levelRationale: Specific5.1 B2 provides the action needed to report ease/difficulty processing a food.
selections.lowerLevelContrast: digestión nominal process and earlier comer ingestion are related but not identical lexemes.
selections.register: neutral; descriptive consumer use, not professional instruction
selections.region: Pan-Hispanic unless a form note narrows usage; es-ES audio target
selections.formNotes: e→ie in digiero/digiere; e→i digirió/digiriendo; digerir un alimento.
selections.pronunciationNotes: di-ge-RIR; g fricative; di-GIE-ro keeps consonantal g plus ie glide.
uncertainties: Literal digestion only; accepting disturbing news is a different figurative sense.

selections.sense: perceived as difficult to digest
selections.levelRationale: Specific5.1 B2 names a digestive-effect evaluation distinct from bad taste or spoilage.
selections.lowerLevelContrast: No earlier saved pesado food sense was found: B1-F139 is physical weight. This batch separately proposes food-effect pesado at B1; indigesto is the more explicit overlapping digestive adjective.
selections.register: neutral; descriptive consumer use, not professional instruction
selections.region: Pan-Hispanic unless a form note narrows usage; es-ES audio target
selections.formNotes: indigesto/indigesta; resultar indigesto; avoid equating with poisonous.
selections.pronunciationNotes: in-di-GES-to; g fricative before e.
uncertainties: Selected literal report; figurative dull/tedious uses deferred to their discourse context.

selections.sense: refrain from eating for a period
selections.levelRationale: Specific5.1 B2 supports reporting a fasting practice or instruction one has received without recommending it.
selections.lowerLevelContrast: Not simply missing a meal accidentally; earlier no comer can paraphrase but does not replace this lexical action.
selections.register: neutral; descriptive consumer use, not professional instruction
selections.region: Pan-Hispanic unless a form note narrows usage; es-ES audio target
selections.formNotes: Regular -ar; ayunar; en ayunas is related expression requiring separate counting decision later.
selections.pronunciationNotes: a-yu-NAR; y consonant, no forced vowel hiatus.
uncertainties: No fasting regimen, medical necessity or religious generalization.

selections.sense: decayed through rotting as organic matter
selections.levelRationale: Specific5.1 B2 distinguishes decay from a passed label date or unwanted taste.
selections.lowerLevelContrast: B1-H042 en mal estado is broader; A2 caducado concerns date, not observed decomposition.
selections.register: neutral; descriptive consumer use, not professional instruction
selections.region: Pan-Hispanic unless a form note narrows usage; es-ES audio target
selections.formNotes: podrido/podrida; irregular participle/adjective family of pudrir/podrir; no safety conclusion from appearance.
selections.pronunciationNotes: po-DRI-do; dr cluster.
uncertainties: Same decay property may be S organic matter; final dedup must not make food-only duplicate.

selections.sense: undergo rotting or organic decay
selections.levelRationale: Specific5.1 B2 supplies the change process rather than only the resulting rotten state.
selections.lowerLevelContrast: Earlier estropearse is broader malfunction/damage; physical decay is a distinct mechanism meaning, not any broken appliance.
selections.register: neutral; descriptive consumer use, not professional instruction
selections.region: Pan-Hispanic unless a form note narrows usage; es-ES audio target
selections.formNotes: Pronominal change; es-ES pudrirse, se pudre, se pudrió and participle podrido. RAE admits selected podri- variants in much American usage; do not impose es-ES forms universally.
selections.pronunciationNotes: pu-DRIR-se; dr cluster; po-DRI-do participle.
uncertainties: Shared organic-decay meaning with S; regional paradigm is documented rather than unresolved. No storage or safety guidance.

selections.sense: suitable to be eaten in the ordinary categorical meaning
selections.levelRationale: Specific5.5 B2 contrasts edible category with pleasant flavour in a food discussion.
selections.lowerLevelContrast: A1 rico is tasty; the adjective does not validate a particular unidentified mushroom or spoiled product.
selections.register: neutral; descriptive consumer use, not professional instruction
selections.region: Pan-Hispanic unless a form note narrows usage; es-ES audio target
selections.formNotes: Gender invariant; comestibles; in- negative is a linked contrast needing form policy.
selections.pronunciationNotes: co-mes-TI-ble; bl cluster and final e.
uncertainties: Never use this label to certify a real item's safety; not specialist toxicology.

selections.sense: having a noticeable pleasant flavour
selections.levelRationale: Specific5.5 B2 adds a flavour-focused evaluative alternative in a review.
selections.lowerLevelContrast: A1 rico already evaluates taste; this is an added lexical form with flavour emphasis, not an unavailable earlier concept.
selections.register: neutral; descriptive consumer use, not professional instruction
selections.region: Pan-Hispanic unless a form note narrows usage; es-ES audio target
selections.formNotes: sabroso/sabrosa and plurals; no automatic noun sabor duplication.
selections.pronunciationNotes: sa-BRO-so; br cluster, both s /s/.
uncertainties: Earlier introduction plausible; B2 nomination relies on source/form expansion, not a longer review sentence.

selections.sense: the felt surface or internal consistency of a material or food
selections.levelRationale: Provides a general sensory dimension for explaining crisp versus smooth food or fabric feel.
selections.lowerLevelContrast: Earlier duro/blando and B1 suave name values, not the dimension; food/material contexts may share the noun. Exact B2-F119 textura proposes the same material-feel parent at B2.
selections.register: neutral; descriptive consumer use, not professional instruction
selections.region: Pan-Hispanic unless a form note narrows usage; es-ES audio target
selections.formNotes: Feminine; textura de; texturas for types.
selections.pronunciationNotes: tex-TU-ra; x usually /ks/, avoid inserted vowel.
uncertainties: Original sensory-comparison nomination; F/P material perception shares one meaning.

selections.sense: making a crisp cracking sound when bitten or pressed
selections.levelRationale: Distinguishes a crisp cooking result from mere hardness in an ordinary food review.
selections.lowerLevelContrast: Earlier duro is resistance, not sound/texture; crunching paper may share the same property.
selections.register: neutral; descriptive consumer use, not professional instruction
selections.region: Pan-Hispanic unless a form note narrows usage; es-ES audio target
selections.formNotes: Gender invariant; crujientes; crujir is linked verb not automatically selected.
selections.pronunciationNotes: cru-JIEN-te; j fricative, ie glide, cr cluster.
uncertainties: Original texture contrast; not a PCIC B2 headword certification.
